correctness.rationale: The exhaustive generator is exact because after appending a bit to an already \(\frac{8}{3}\)-free prefix, every newly created forbidden factor must be a suffix; for each period \(p\), checking suffix length \(\lceil 8p/3\rceil\) is necessary and sufficient. Every survivor through length 30 is generated, no word below length 30 is extremal, and exactly two length-30 words are extremal. A second definition-level routine recomputes the least period of every factor of both witnesses and of all 124 inserted extensions.

value.rationale: The threshold \(\frac{8}{3}\) is the upper endpoint of the direct source’s existence theorem and the conjectured binary extremal repetition threshold. Determining the exact first length and all extremizers at that boundary is a natural complete finite classification, not an arbitrary cutoff. It also replaces the source’s first possible displayed endpoint-family length 86 by the true minimum 30 and supplies a compact regression pair for future structural work.
